36153-memorial-day-and-other-verse-origi.title: (_Original And Translated_)
36153-memorial-day-and-other-verse-origi.creator: Unknown
36153-memorial-day-and-other-verse-origi.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. No warrior he, a village lad,  needing nor words nor other prod   To point his duty; he was glad  to tread the path his fathers trod. Week days he worked in wood and field;  with homely joys he decked his life;   The sword of hate he would not wield,  nor take a part in cankering strife.

arxiv-1609-03434.title: Surface superconductivity as the primary cause of broadening of superconducting transition in Nb-films
arxiv-1609-03434.creator: A. Zeinali, V. M. Krasnov
arxiv-1609-03434.description: A 2016 arXiv research paper by A. Zeinali, V. M. Krasnov. We study the origin of broadening of superconducting transition in sputtered Nb films. From simultaneous tunneling and transport measurements we conclude that the upper critical field H c ​ 2 H_{c2} always corresponds to the bottom of transition R ∼ 0 R\sim 0 , while the top R ∼ R n R\sim R_{n} occurs close to the critical field for destruction of surface superconductivity H c ​ 3 ≃ 1.7 ​ H c ​ 2 H_{c3}\simeq 1.7H_{c2} .

arxiv-2208-13167.title: Large amplitude radially symmetric spots and gaps in a dryland ecosystem model
arxiv-2208-13167.creator: Eleanor Byrnes, Paul Carter, Arjen Doelman, Lily Liu
arxiv-2208-13167.description: Abstract We construct far-from-onset radially symmetric spot and gap solutions in a two-component dryland ecosystem model of vegetation pattern formation on flat terrain, using spatial dynamics and geometric singular perturbation theory. We draw connections between the geometry of the spot and gap solutions with that of traveling and stationary front solutions in the same model.

arxiv-2208-14041.title: Chiral phonon in the cubic system based on the Laves phase of A A Bi 2 ( A = A= K, Rb, Cs)
arxiv-2208-14041.creator: Surajit Basak, Przemysław Piekarz, Andrzej Ptok
arxiv-2208-14041.description: Abstract A A B 2 ( A = A= K, Rb, Cs) compounds crystallize in the cubic Laves phase (symmetry Fd 3 ¯ \bar{3} m). The geometry of the crystal structure allows the realization of chiral phonons, which are associated with the circulation of atoms around their equilibrium positions.

arxiv-2212-13315.title: The perfectoid Tate algebra has uncountable Krull dimension
arxiv-2212-13315.creator: Jack J Garzella
arxiv-2212-13315.description: Abstract Let K K be a perfectoid field with pseudo-uniformizer π \pi . We adapt an argument of Du in [ Du20 ] to show that the perfectoid Tate algebra K ​ ⟨ x 1 / p ∞ ⟩ K\langle x^{1/p^{\infty}}\rangle has an uncountable chain of distinct prime ideals.

arxiv-2305-07702.title: Dynamics of false vacuum bubbles with trapped particles
arxiv-2305-07702.creator: Marek Lewicki, Kristjan Müürsepp, Joosep Pata, Martin Vasar, Ville Vaskonen, Hardi Veermäe
arxiv-2305-07702.description: Abstract We study the impact of the ambient fluid on the evolution of collapsing false vacuum bubbles by simulating the dynamics of a coupled bubble-particle system. A significant increase in the mass of the particles across the bubble wall leads to a buildup of those particles inside the false vacuum bubble.

arxiv-2310-18366.title: A Multilingual Virtual Guide for Self-Attachment Technique
arxiv-2310-18366.creator: Alicia Jiayun Law 1,† , Ruoyu Hu 1,2,† , Lisa Alazraki 1 , Anandha Gopalan 1 , Neophytos Polydorou 1,2 , Abbas Edalat 1
arxiv-2310-18366.description: Abstract In this work, we propose a computational framework that leverages existing out-of-language data to create a conversational agent for the delivery of Self-Attachment Technique (SAT) in Mandarin. Our framework does not require large-scale human translations, yet it achieves a comparable performance whilst also maintaining safety and reliability.

arxiv-2407-03660.description: Abstract . Ramanujan’s famous formula for ζ ⁡ ( 2 ​ m + 1 ) \zeta(2m+1) has captivated the attention of numerous mathematicians over the years. Grosswald, in 1972, found a simple extension of Ramanujan’s formula which in turn gives transformation formula for Eisenstein series over the full modular group.

arxiv-2502-02155.title: A Survey on Ordered Ramsey Numbers Thanks: M. Balko was supported by grant no. 23-04949X of the Czech Science Foundation (GAČR) and by the Center for Foundations of Modern Computer Science (Charles Univ. project UNCE 24/SCI/008).
arxiv-2502-02155.creator: Martin Balko 1
arxiv-2502-02155.description: Abstract The ordered Ramsey number of a graph G < G^{<} with a linearly ordered vertex set is the smallest positive integer N N such that any two-coloring of the edges of the ordered complete graph on N N vertices contains a monochromatic copy of G < G^{<} in the given ordering.

arxiv-2506-05576.title: TD-TOG Dataset: Benchmarking Zero-Shot and One-Shot Task-Oriented Grasping for Object Generalization
arxiv-2506-05576.creator: Valerija Holomjova, Jamie Grech, Dewei Yi, Bruno Yun, Andrew Starkey, Pascal Meißner
arxiv-2506-05576.description: Abstract Task-oriented grasping (TOG) is an essential preliminary step for robotic task execution, which involves predicting grasps on regions of target objects that facilitate intended tasks. Existing literature reveals there is a limited availability of TOG datasets for training and benchmarking despite large demand, which are often synthetic or have artifacts in mask annotations that hinder model performance.

arxiv-2508-15962.title: A sample article title
arxiv-2508-15962.creator: Nicholas Woolsey, Xianzheng Huang
arxiv-2508-15962.description: Abstract This study considers regression analysis of a circular response with an error-prone linear covariate. Starting with an existing estimator of the circular regression function that assumes error-free covariate, three approaches are proposed to revise this estimator, leading to three nonparametric estimators for the circular regression function accounting for measurement error.

europmc-pmc7896046.title: Evolution of immune responses to SARS-CoV-2 in mild-moderate COVID-19.
europmc-pmc7896046.creator: Wheatley AK, Juno JA, Wang JJ, Selva KJ, Reynaldi A, Tan HX, Lee WS, Wragg KM, Kelly HG, Esterbauer R, Davis SK, Kent HE, Mordant FL, Schlub TE, Gordon DL, Khoury DS, Subbarao K, Cromer D, Gordon TP, Chung AW, Davenport MP, Kent SJ.
europmc-pmc7896046.description: The durability of infection-induced SARS-CoV-2 immunity has major implications for reinfection and vaccine development. Here, we show a comprehensive profile of antibody, B cell and T cell dynamics over time in a cohort of patients who have recovered from mild-moderate COVID-19.

pmc-12411288.title: Sudden Unexpected Death in Epilepsy: From Short-Term Risk Prediction to Mechanistic Insights and Preventive Strategies
pmc-12411288.creator: Jung Bin Kim
pmc-12411288.description: ch Database, represents the most-extensive short-term (30-day) sudden-death risk model published to date, offering timely insights for both clinicians and researchers.1 The authors identified 3,454 cases (2.1%) of sudden death within 30 days of observation and developed a logistic regression model with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.752.

pmc-12537478.title: Optimizing sarcopenia screening in type 2 diabetes mellitus: A ROC curve evaluation of the SARC-F and the SARC-CalF
pmc-12537478.creator: Shu-Ying Su, Chizimuzo T.C. Okoli, Li-Fen Chao
pmc-12537478.description: ObjectivesSarcopenia is highly prevalent in older adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM), significantly increasing fall and disability risks. While the Questionnaire composed of “Strength, Assistance in walking, Rising from a chair, Climbing stairs, and Falls” (SARC-F) is commonly used for sarcopenia screening, its diagnostic accuracy in T2DM patients remains unclear.

pmc-12729637.title: Prevalence and Antimicrobial Resistance of Staphylococcus aureus and Staphylococcus schleiferi Isolated from Dogs with Otitis Externa and Healthy Dogs
pmc-12729637.creator: Ionela Popa, Ionica Iancu, Vlad Iorgoni, Janos Degi, Alexandru Gligor, Kalman Imre, Emil Tîrziu, Timea Bochiș, Călin Pop, Ana-Maria Plotuna, Paula Nistor, Marius Pentea, Viorel Herman, Ileana Nichita, Djamel Drider, Raffaele Scarpellini
pmc-12729637.description: Background/Objectives: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in companion animals is a growing One Health concern due to the close interaction between pets and humans. Staphylococcus aureus (S. aureus) and Staphylococcus schleiferi (S. schleiferi) are common colonizers of the canine ear canal and can act as reservoirs of resistance. This study aimed to assess the prevalence and antimicrobial resistance profiles of S.

pmc-13113907.title: Knowledge, Attitudes and Practices Related to Antimicrobial Use and Resistance Among Livestock Sector Stakeholders in Seven Former Soviet Countries: A Multi-Country Regional Analysis
pmc-13113907.creator: Dora Kovacs, Eran Raizman, Anne Deckert, Chichak Aliyeva, Dragan Angelovski, Zaruhi Beglaryan, Duriya Charypkhan, Natalia Ciria, Tolibjon Khakimov, Maripa Kichinebatyrova, Elvira Maratova, Tamas Nagy, Anna Sargsyan, Oksana Yurchenko, Daniel Beltran-Alcrudo
pmc-13113907.description: Background/Objectives: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is one of the greatest health threats affecting humans, animals and the environment. Antimicrobial use (AMU) in the livestock sector contributes to the development and spread of AMR, highlighting the need to understand the current situation, to target knowledge gaps and non-prudent practices with tailored interventions, and improve antimicrobial stewardship.

pmc-13237324.title: Trans-ethnic estimation and implications of genetic impact on continuous glycemic profiles
pmc-13237324.creator: Evan Yi-Wen Yu, Hui-Ying Ren, Xinxiu Liang, Yue Xi, Menglei Shuai, Zelei Miao, Fengzhe Xu, Ke Zhang, Luqi Shen, Hui Xia, Miranda T Schram, Marleen van Greevenbroek, Bastiaan E de Galan, Carla J H van der Kallen, David E J Linden, Gabriëlla A M Blokland, Ilja C W Arts, Tos T J M Berendschot, Yan Yan,
pmc-13237324.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The genetic architecture of glycemic dynamic metrics derived from continuous-glucose monitoring (CGM) across different populations remains poorly understood. Here, we conducted a trans-ethnic genome-wide association study (GWAS) meta-analysis of 20 CGM-derived glycemic traits, building upon a previously established European-ancestry CGM dataset and extending it through the inclusion of additional cohorts, in up to 9677 individuals originating from 2051 Chinese, 901 Dutch, and 6725 Israelis.

pmc-13297630.title: Role of MAPK Pathways in the Pathogenesis of Vitiligo
pmc-13297630.creator: Yuexi Liu, Yukun Yuan, Xiaoyi Shi, Rongsi Sun, Xiaolan Ding
pmc-13297630.description: Vitiligo is a chronic, acquired autoimmune disorder characterized by white skin patches resulting from the loss of epidermal melanocytes. Vitiligo may arise through multiple mechanisms, including genetic susceptibility, oxidative stress, autoimmune dysfunction, and environmental factors. Treatment strategies have focused on inhibiting melanocyte loss and stimulating repigmentation.

pmc-13400236.title: Radiographic evolution of a dentigerous cyst associated with a deeply impacted mandibular first molar in a pediatric patient: a CBCT-based longitudinal case report with minimal-visit orthodontic management
pmc-13400236.creator: Huyen Nguyen Thanh, Manh Nguyen Truong, Anh Vu Dinh Viet, Hoang Viet Do, Trang Thi Thu Vu
pmc-13400236.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). A deeply impacted mandibular first molar associated with a dentigerous cyst is an uncommon clinical presentation, particularly in pediatric patients. This case report describes a 9-year-old boy who presented with delayed eruption of the mandibular right first molar. Panoramic radiography revealed a well-defined unilocular radiolucent lesion associated with a deeply impacted tooth, while cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) demonstrated buccolingual cortical expansion and thinning, displacement of the adjacent second molar germ, and close proximity to the inferior alveolar canal.

pmc-13427969.title: Real-World Treatment Patterns in Advanced Cutaneous Melanoma in the USA
pmc-13427969.creator: Matthew S. Block, Ashley E. Stenzel, Rene Marcotte, Katrine L. Wallace
pmc-13427969.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). pmc-13633885.title: A case of subserosal bile infiltration due to gallbladder injury during robot-assisted nephrectomy (with video)
pmc-13633885.creator: Shunryo Minezaki, Fumihiko Miura, Keisuke Ueno, Yasuyuki Ikehata, Akitoshi Nankaku, Kenji Yamazaki, Junpei Takashima, Daisuke Fujimoto, Hirotoshi Kobayashi, Minato Yokoyama, Tatsuya Aso, Mikiko Takahashi, Keiji Sano, Yosuke Inoue, Takeo Fukagawa
pmc-13633885.description: With the spread of minimally invasive surgery (MIS), various MIS-specific iatrogenic complications have been reported; however, subserosal bile infiltration of the gallbladder has not been documented. We report a case of subserosal bile infiltration occurring during robot-assisted radical right nephrectomy for clear cell renal carcinoma after robot-assisted partial nephrectomy.
